text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":2,"unit":"shelves","kind":"count","span":"the middle 2 shelves"},{"id":"q2","value":10,"unit":"books","kind":"count","span":"can hold 10 books"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"twice as many books as a middle shelf"},{"id":"q4","value":5,"unit":"books","kind":"count","span":"5 fewer books than the bottom shelf"},{"id":"q5","value":110,"unit":"books","kind":"count","span":"she has 110 books"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"total capacity of the 2 middle shelves"},{"op":"mul","args":["q3","q2"],"out":"s2","note":"bottom shelf capacity, twice a middle shelf"},{"op":"sub","args":["s2","q4"],"out":"s3","note":"top shelf capacity, 5 fewer than the bottom shelf"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","s2"],"out":"s4","note":"middle shelves plus bottom shelf capacity"},{"op":"add","args":["s4","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"total capacity of one bookcase"},{"op":"div","args":["q5","s5"],"out":"s6","note":"number of bookcases needed to hold all 110 books"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"how many bookcases Elly needs to hold all her books"},"dismissed":[]}
